The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 test, 1 passing, 0 failing.

**Cause:** Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. The in-memory `Db` rejects unknown columns, so the insert threw.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two references from `full_name` to `fullname`, the name production already has. The change is two lines in one file. I did not touch `migrations/`, which is unchanged.

I didn't commit anything, since you didn't ask for a commit.
